entries.title: Task-queue handoff is the multi-agent protocol
entries.body: agent_tasks table (from_agent, to_agent, task_type, payload, due_at, status) is the delegation mechanism. The delegating agent decides via a tool call (schedule_followup); the receiving agent runs its own Claude loop independently. Proven live: Secretary booked, delegated, Follow-up composed and sent the reminder. Reuse for every future role.

entries.title: Service layer separation enables agent reuse
entries.body: booking/knowledge as plain Python services (no agent imports) meant the Follow-up agent reused them with zero changes â€” validating the design constraint set at init. Keep all business capability in app/services/, agents only orchestrate.

entries.title: Machine Python is 3.14.6, not configured 3.12
entries.body: All dependencies (fastapi, anthropic, pydantic) are compatible with 3.14.6. Config updated to match reality at the 2026-11-21 retro.

entries.title: Secrets go only in gitignored .env, never .env.example
entries.body: User pasted a real API key into the tracked .env.example â€” would have leaked to GitHub on next push. Moved to .env and restored the placeholder before any commit. Always double-check which env file receives a secret; .env.example is public documentation.

entries.title: Windows zombie socket can hold a port after process death
entries.body: A killed PID (5664) remained in netstat as LISTENING on 127.0.0.1:8000 with no live process. New binds fail with WinError 10048. Fastest fix: use another port; a reboot clears the zombie entry.

entries.title: gh OAuth needs 'workflow' scope to push CI files
entries.body: A default `gh auth login` token lacks the workflow scope; pushing .github/workflows/*.yml is rejected by GitHub. Fix: `gh auth refresh -h github.com -s workflow` (device-code flow).

entries.title: FastAPI form webhooks need python-multipart
entries.body: Twilio posts form-encoded bodies; FastAPI/Starlette form parsing requires the python-multipart package or every webhook request 500s. It is easy to miss locally because nothing imports it directly. Fix: add python-multipart to requirements whenever a route reads request.form().

entries.title: Bare pytest and python -m pytest resolve imports differently
entries.body: `python -m pytest` adds the cwd to sys.path; bare `pytest` does not. A repo with no root conftest.py/pyproject can pass locally and fail collection in CI with ModuleNotFoundError. Fix: an empty root conftest.py (or pythonpath in pyproject). Also: verify CI is actually green after scaffolding it — this repo's CI had failed on every run since creation without being noticed.

entries.title: ADD 0.11.0 plugin cache ships without scripts/check-test-count.py
entries.body: The tdd-cycle skill's RED/GREEN snapshot command points at {plugin}/../../scripts/check-test-count.py, which does not exist in the installed plugin cache. Workaround: manual snapshot JSON from `pytest --collect-only -q` (functions list + count) at .add/cycles/cycle-N/, compared by hand at verify Gate 3.5. Report upstream to MountainUnicorn/add.

entries.title: zoneinfo needs the tzdata package on Windows
entries.body: Python's zoneinfo has no IANA database on Windows (and slim Docker images): ZoneInfo('UTC') raises 'No time zone found with key UTC'. Any code touching timezones must ship the tzdata pip package. Caught here only because a test exercised the real code path — fail-open error handling had masked it into an empty result.

entries.title: US SMS requires A2P 10DLC registration — even on Twilio trial
entries.body: US carriers reject SMS from unregistered local 10DLC numbers with err 30034 (inbound unaffected). No API bypass; A2P brand/campaign registration (or verified toll-free) takes business details and days. Kick it off well before any live SMS milestone — it gated the M3 smoke test. Registered at production-deploy time (M4).

entries.title: Twilio WhatsApp: skip the sandbox, register a real sender
entries.body: The sandbox can be OFFLINE account-wide (every join fails with an opaque error; no API to inspect or fix). The reliable path: Meta embedded signup registers your Twilio number as a real sender (SMS code to the number), webhook set via Senders API v2 (messaging.twilio.com/v2/Channels/Senders/{sid}). Gotchas: new WABA stays locked (err 63051) until Meta business verification (~3h observed); sends during webhook update (ONLINE:UPDATING) fail with 63007 — wait ~1 min after changes.

entries.title: Cloudflare quick tunnels die permanently and rotate URLs
entries.body: Cloudflare's edge drops quick tunnels after a few hours ('Unauthorized: Tunnel not found'); cloudflared retries forever but can never re-register — restart required, which issues a NEW random URL. Recovery routine: restart tunnel, re-point every webhook via API, expect minutes of DNS propagation (Twilio reports err 11210 meanwhile; its resolver caches the negative answer). Run a log watcher on the death signature. For anything beyond a throwaway session use a named tunnel or ngrok with a reserved domain.

entries.title: Rename cloud credential downloads to the gitignored name immediately
entries.body: Google SA keys download as {project}-{hash}.json, which .gitignore patterns written for data/google-sa.json or *-sa.json do NOT match — the key sat trackable in data/ until renamed. Same session: real Twilio creds were pasted into a tracked doc (docs/smoke-test.md) and scrubbed pre-commit. Pattern (2nd+3rd occurrence after WL-001): secrets drift into tracked files during setup flows; always route credentials straight to their gitignored destination and verify with git status.

entries.title: A populated .env leaks into unit tests via load_dotenv at collection
entries.body: pytest imports every test module at collection, so any module importing the app entrypoint runs load_dotenv() before the first test executes — real credentials then enable live integration paths suite-wide (7 booking tests silently hit the real Google Calendar). Invisible until the day .env gains real creds; tests pass in isolation, fail in the full run. Fix: an autouse fixture that delenvs all integration vars; tests opt in with monkeypatch.setenv.
